name: City of Verona
description: Verona sits in Italy's Veneto region, its old centre looped by the Adige River. Founded in the 1st century B.C., it still has a Roman amphitheatre, the Arena, which hosts open-air opera each summer. Walk on to find medieval rulers' monuments, Venetian-era fortifications, and the Casa di Giulietta, whose famous balcony was added in the 1930s.
